title: memory.agent.skill.proposed v1
description: EverOS distilled a SKILL.md from successful agent runs, and adapters/everos-sink proposes it for review. A person gates it as a PR to agent-skills; it never auto-loads. IDS AND METADATA ONLY: the payload never carries the skill body. Private projects (tachyonac) publish to the private overlay, never here. Design: nervous-bus#115.

app_id.description: EverOS app scope: the project the runs came from.

agent_id.description: Assistant-side sender id the cases were extracted for (claude-code, codex, ...).

skill_name.description: Skill directory name, skills/skill_<name>/ in EverOS.

md_path.description: SKILL.md path relative to the EverOS memory root.

case_count.description: agent_case entries the skill was clustered from.

session_ids.description: Sessions behind those cases, when known.

pr_url.description: The agent-skills PR opened for review, once it exists.

proposed_at.description: When the sink proposed the skill (RFC3339 UTC).
